title: savefig
summary: Save one or more figures as RunMat FIG files.

gpu_support.notes: `savefig` serializes figure scene state and gathers only metadata arguments.

tested.integration: single and multiple figure round-trip tests

description: `savefig` writes RunMat FIG files that can be reopened by `openfig` and `hgload`.
behaviors: `savefig(filename)` saves the current figure and appends `.fig` when no extension is present.
`savefig(fig, filename)` accepts a scalar figure handle or an array of figure handles.
`savefig(fig, filename, version)` accepts MATLAB version tokens `-v6`, `-v7`, `-v7.3`, and `compact` as compatibility options for the RunMat FIG scene format.

Figure handles are double graphics identities and filenames/version tokens are text. Direct typed-integer or gpuArray arguments are invalid and reject before file I/O; native integer graphics source data is serialized through the scene payload rather than converted into a direct argument.

examples.description: Save and reopen the current figure

gpu_residency: `savefig` writes host or virtual-filesystem bytes and returns a host logical status.
gpu_behavior: No numeric GPU kernel is launched.
The figure scene exporter preserves existing plotting state without routing through scalar plotting loops.
